Package cafe94.system.model.booking

Class Booking

java.lang.Object
cafe94.system.model.booking.Booking
public class Booking extends Object
Represents a booking made by a customer to eat in the restaurant. Includes information about the number of guests, date, time, duration, and booking status.

  • Constructor Details

    • Booking

      public Booking(int customerID, int guestNum, String date, String time, int durationHours)
      Creates a new booking with default status of PENDING.
      Parameters:
      customerID - ID of the customer making the booking
      guestNum - number of guests
      date - date of booking in YYYY-MM-DD
      time - time of booking in HH:MM
      durationHours - duration in hours (defaults to 1 but can be more)
